models_evaluated: KIMI (RevelAi Health) LLM with retrieval-augmented generation and system-prompt layer

links.outcome: Agreement between reviewer-assigned and LLM-assigned acuity levels for simulated distal radius fracture queries
links.effect: Exact acuity agreement 62.9% (95% CI 58.0 to 67.7); LLM-assigned acuity associated with reviewer acuity (OR 2.66, 95% CI 1.81 to 3.83); responses rated safe 94.2%.
links.quote: Posterior average probability of exact agreement between reviewer-assigned and LLM-assigned acuity levels was 62.9% (95% CI: 58.0 to 67.7).

screen.reason: Evaluates the performance and safety of an RAG-enhanced LLM system (KIMI) on simulated patient queries for distal radius fracture triage and response generation without an experimental comparison of deployment practices.
